snapshot.text: Largely public, free-at-the-point-of-use health system with social security covering most of the population. The health ministry's agenda in 2026 includes cancer control, domestic vaccine production and occupational health.

priorities.title: New phase in cancer control
priorities.text: The minister announced a new, more effective phase in tackling cancer.

priorities.title: National vaccine production
priorities.text: He called for a clear roadmap to develop national vaccine production.

priorities.title: Occupational health
priorities.text: Occupational health is being put at the centre of labour policy.
